title: Requests waiting on outside companies, each a Pulse case until answered
why: Jason, 2026-11-17, after sending Name.com's API support a reseller pricing request (ticket #3113488): "pulse this." Pulse builds its cases from the site's own sources, so there was no way to track something we're waiting on from a company. Each company card on Outside services now has Waiting on them, with Add a request (what you asked, ticket number, link; Executives and the Founder, like the cards' sign-in notes). Each open request is its own Pulse case, 'Waiting on <company>: <what> (ticket #…)', an Update that turns to an Alert after 5 days without an answer, with steps: Open their support, Chase them (noted), Record their answer (kept on the case; it closes). Kept in staff_settings as outreq:<id>, like the sign-in notes, so no new table. Name.com's reseller pricing request, ticket #3113488 sent 2026-11-17, is added once by the code (a marker stops a second time), so its case is there when this is live.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
